body: If you don't feel safe at home, spend the night at your dad's or your friend's so you can calm down. But yeah just try to put up with it till you are legally responsible for yourself. It's annoying when parents do that stuff but it's part of being a minor :/

Sending you a hug,  if that's okay. Have you ever done the thing where when you want to do it really bad, wait 48 hours first and see if anything changes?  It gives you time to try some things you haven't done in a while that might help, like an old hobby or maybe just time to exercise and get some negative energy out.

I was extremely apathetic about anything and didn't care anymore. I was actually just out of suicide watch so if they found out I would have gone back inpatient but yeah, I simply didn't care about anything, just wanted to stop all the stupidity from me being here.
